about.heroStatement: I build digital experiences that feel as good as they work.
about.subStatement: Developer, builder, and problem solver creating thoughtful products with code, design, and curiosity.
bioParagraphs: I believe software shouldn't just be functional—it should be crafted with taste, clarity, and deep attention to detail.

With a background bridging software architecture and interaction design, I build applications that blend technical rigor with artistic nuance. From zero-to-one product engineering to refined micro-interactions, I treat every project as both a system and a visual canvas.
When I'm not writing code, I'm experimenting with generative visual algorithms, reading editorial design literature, or sketching interface ideas.
about.philosophyQuote: Good software should disappear behind the experience.
